paper_role: independent direct-mechanism extension after Palmer aggregate-history analyses

already_published: Dugger et al. 2010 and later Ross Sea work establish inter-colony movement and breeding philopatry in Adelie penguins.

The 2026 Frontiers 25-year mark-recapture analysis estimates age-, reproductive-state-, and colony-specific survival, recruitment, breeding propensity and inter-colony transition probabilities for Royds, Bird and Crozier.
That 2026 model includes age, reproductive state and colony effects on transitions but does not use previous-year colony reproductive performance as a time-varying transition covariate.
novelty_boundary.target_gap: Does previous-year colony reproductive performance predict an individual bird's subsequent breeding-state/colony transition, beyond age, origin colony and reproductive state?
novelty_boundary.prohibited_novelty_claim: Do not claim first measurement of Adelie dispersal, prospecting, breeding philopatry or colony transitions.

resighting.title: Adelie penguin resighting data 1997-2021 from the California Avian Data Center hosted by Point Reyes Bird Observatory Conservation Science

banding.title: Adelie penguin banding data 1994-2021 from the California Avian Data Center hosted by Point Reyes Bird Observatory Conservation Science

chick_counts.title: Adelie penguin chick counts 1997-2009 from the California Avian Data Center hosted by Point Reyes Bird Observatory Conservation Science

allowed_before_GO_decision: whether individual IDs, colony IDs, reproductive status and dates are present
whether chick counts contain a breeding-pair/nest denominator or can be deterministically joined to a frozen denominator source
prohibited_before_GO_decision: selection of years/colonies based on observed effects

resight_schema: observation colony/location distinguishing at least Royds, Bird and Crozier or a documented subset
reproductive state or enough observation fields to classify breeder versus non-breeder without outcome-based recoding
performance_schema: breeding-pair/nest denominator in the same source OR a pre-existing independently documented denominator that can be joined deterministically before movement outcomes are inspected
minimum_overlap_before_outcome_analysis: at least 8 breeding seasons with both performance and resighting coverage
at least 2 colonies with performance estimates in each included season
the exact colony names/codes must map deterministically; no manual value-based crosswalk

performance_state.primary_metric: colony chicks per breeding pair in season t
performance_state.standardization: Within each season, center and scale across the eligible Ross Sea colonies; call this P_colony,t.
performance_state.reason: This is closer to the aggregate chick-production state that carried temporal information at Palmer than the binary monitored-nest endpoint that failed independent replication.

if_GO_analysis_family.primary_population: Birds observed as breeders in colony c during season t, with a classifiable observed state in season t+1.

primary_conditional_outcome.definition: Among birds observed breeding in both t and t+1, whether breeding colony changes.
primary_conditional_outcome.prediction: Lower P_c,t predicts higher probability of breeding dispersal at t+1.

secondary_observed_state_outcome.role: Distinguish breeding dispersal from temporary nonbreeding when reproductive status is available.

prebreeder_settlement_secondary.population: Known-age prebreeders observed at one or more colonies before first breeding, if first-breeding colony can be identified.
prebreeder_settlement_secondary.question: Is first breeding disproportionately directed toward colonies with higher recent P_colony,t, after accounting for natal colony and age?
prebreeder_settlement_secondary.role: Prospecting/settlement test; secondary because candidate-set availability and detection must first pass a separate schema audit.

controls: individual previous breeding experience when derivable before the transition

inference.primary_model: conditional logistic/binomial model on birds observed breeding in consecutive seasons
inference.primary_coefficient: effect of origin-colony P_c,t on probability of different-colony breeding at t+1
inference.expected_sign: negative P increases movement; equivalently coefficient of P on movement probability < 0
inference.permutation_null: Permute P_colony,t among eligible colonies within season, preserving all bird histories, age, origin colony, observation/missingness structure and transition outcomes.
inference.p_value: one-sided lower-tail for the productivity coefficient

minimum_information.failure_rule: STOP without fitting the performance effect if any minimum is not met.

sensitivity_if_GO: Restrict to adults age >=5 if age is available.
Exclude giant-iceberg years 2001/02-2005/06 as a predeclared environmental-disruption sensitivity.
Repeat using colony productivity rank within season rather than z score.
Leave one colony out when at least two colonies remain and the minimum event count is satisfied.

detection_boundary.primary_conditional_model: The primary analysis is explicitly conditional on birds observed breeding in consecutive seasons; it estimates observed breeding dispersal among detected breeders, not unconditional population transition probability.
detection_boundary.multistate_extension: If the exact observation-effort schema is sufficient to reproduce the 2026 multi-state capture-recapture model without outcome-dependent choices, a separate contract may be frozen before fitting a performance-covariate multi-state extension.
detection_boundary.nondetection: Nondetection must never be coded as death, dispersal or nonbreeding.

decision.GO: Freeze exact column mappings and data-cleaning semantics in a second contract before any performance-movement coefficient is computed.
decision.STOP: If schema, colony mapping, performance denominator or minimum temporal overlap fails, do not substitute another movement endpoint or performance metric post hoc.

claim_boundaries: A conditional detected-breeder analysis would not estimate unconditional dispersal probabilities.
A performance effect would support performance-linked movement, not prove that birds cognitively use public information.
No claim may be made that Palmer and Ross Sea share the same mechanism unless the external test passes its frozen rule.
Do not replace chicks-per-pair with another performance metric after movement outcomes are opened.
